{{Quote|From it, we've been able to determine that Skywalker went to Dagobah.|The Sith cultist, to Alora|<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
A '''Sith cultist''' was a member of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] group. He was among the forces [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis|sent]] to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and he cracked into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] records, discovering that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had gone to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. After the cultist reported his discovery to [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], he was discovered and slain by [[Jaden Korr]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
The Sith cultist wielded a red-bladed [[lightsaber]].
